environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Node.js 18.x) deployed in a VPC with a standard S3 VPC endpoint (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3) using the default full-access endpoint policy. The Lambda execution role has s3:PutObject permission with Resource: 'arn:aws:s3:::*/*'. The function processes document uploads from an SQS queue. No additional network controls or bucket policies restrict cross-bucket writes.

config.network: VPC with S3 gateway endpoint, default policy
